chunks: 4698 - And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever takes care of three daughters or three sisters, Paradise becomes obligatory for him."
It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, and two?"
It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, and one?"

key_terms.عَالَ: supported, maintained, and took care of financially and practically
key_terms.وَاثْنَتَيْنِ: two as carrying the same reward
key_terms.وَوَاحِدَةً: one as also carrying the same reward

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for taking care of daughters or sisters in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of caring for daughters and sisters, promising jannah to the one who supports and raises them. It emphasizes compassion, family responsibility, and the spiritual reward attached to fulfilling these duties even if the number is two or one.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4698 - The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever takes care of three daughters or three sisters, Paradise becomes obligatory for him."
It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), what about two?"
It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), and one?"
